decisions.reason: Larson et al. (2010) collect two-session flanker-task ERP data (N = 20 across a 2-week retest interval) to re-test the test-retest reliability (temporal stability) of grand mean ERN and Pe amplitudes, finding moderate to good temporal stability via intraclass and zero-order correlations (ERN ICC = .66, r = .49; CRN ICC = .75, r = .72; Pe ICC = .48, r = .32; ROI ERN ICC = .77, Pe ICC = .79) and explicitly concluding in the Discussion that their results replicate the temporal stability findings of both Olvet & Hajcak (2009a) and Segalowitz et al. (2010). The reference list (lines 319-322) identifies Segalowitz, S. J., Santesso, D. L., Murphy, T. I., Homan, D., Chantziantoniou, D. K., & Khan, S. (2010), 'Retest reliability of medial frontal negativities during performance monitoring', Psychophysiology (in press), with no DOI printed in the text. The sole shipped row (input_row_index 664) is Olvet & Hajcak (2009a) in Brain Research (DOI 10.1016/j.brainres.2009.05.079), which is a separate primary study by different authors in a different journal; no prior adjudication/state files existed at the supplied paths.
